reviewer: Agent visual and ordinary-input task review; no human novice study

before.scope: Accepted native M13.6 chrome at 1024x768, compared qualitatively with M13.7 files-1024/common-frame.png; directory contents differ

clarity.notes: Back/Forward/Up/Refresh, explicit compact Address, recognizable places, More and item/match counts have distinct purposes. Query Enter selects without launching and no-match text explains recovery.

convenience.notes: Single-click selection, existing context commands, current-folder filtering, preserved sort/view and same-window Enter navigation keep ordinary tasks local; small windows retain Places and More.

friendliness.notes: Native dialogs retain cancel/consent, protected actions remain unavailable, USB filtering is explicitly unavailable, and Eject keeps the flush guard. Offline and website instructions use matching labels.

graphics.notes: Original scalable app/place artwork, shared Inter type, quiet sidebar and two-row common frame remain coherent across ordinary, compact, 150% and actual 4K profiles.

readability.notes: Reviewed native light/dark/high-contrast captures retain readable labels and field content. Minimum 500-unit controls fit; physical 4K uses native smooth type. Optional footer hints may ellipsize without hiding primary actions or errors.

resource_scope: Fixed query state is 704 bytes across eight slots; no new index worker, heap cache or per-keystroke process. Native frame timing remains M13.9.

carry_forward.item: Give the readable high-contrast current-place sidebar a stronger explicit boundary; location remains clear in the caption/breadcrumb. Final M13.12 repeats this check.
Retain the previously recorded notification placement and shared Start/Settings search-hint color work.

scope: Named native tasks and agent visual judgement; no universal ease, screen-reader, physical-device, GPU-3D or Windows capability parity claim. Matching public release/website closure remains separate.
